title: Prototype: redesign the download-site screen into a striking liquid-glass landing page
summary: The UX prototype's download-site screen became a landing page: logo hero, own-system download button first, a glass app-window mock, feature cards, a numbered how-it-works flow and a drifting glow that stops under reduced motion; six new named tokens copied into every token file.
lessons_learned: The Node pin (24.22.2) is not the node on PATH here (24.4.1); it lives under AppData/Roaming/fnm/node-versions/v24.22.2/installation and must be put first on PATH in every brief
The repository went public on 2026-11-03, so GitHub Actions CI runs again on Windows and Mac; the CLAUDE.md rule that the project counts as having no CI is now stale and should be deleted
